data.notes: November is especially strong for London’s citywide festival circuit, large-scale club takeovers and UK-rooted electronic scenes, with Pitchfork, EFG London Jazz Festival, Drumsheds, fabric, FOLD/The Cause and KOKO all active.

events.title: EFG London Jazz Festival 2026
events.summary: EFG London Jazz Festival returns for ten days across the capital, with highlights including Jazz Voice, Goldie, Asha Puthli, Mariza, Caravan Palace, Robert Glasper, Samara Joy and Kyoto Jazz Massive.

events.title: Pitchfork Music Festival London 2026
events.summary: Pitchfork Music Festival London runs across multiple London venues, with announced artists including The Avalanches, Noname, Olof Dreijer, Hania Rani, Thaiboy Digital, The Radio Dept. and more.

events.title: Stevie Wonder: Songs in the Key of Life
events.summary: Stevie Wonder brings his Songs in the Key of Life performances to The O2 on 3 and 5 November, marking the album’s 50th anniversary with the album performed in full.

events.title: Robert Glasper at Blue Note London
events.summary: Robert Glasper plays a sold-out run at Blue Note London during EFG London Jazz Festival, with special guests Marsha Ambrosius on 14–15 November and Common on 20–21 November.

events.title: FUSE 18th Birthday at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: FUSE celebrates its 18th birthday with its biggest London show to date at DRUMSHEDS, featuring Enzo Siragusa B2B Rossi., Luciano, Apollonia, Traumer, Sweely, Dungeon Meat and more.

events.title: Worried About Henry with Wilkinson, Bou, Kanine, Luude and many more
events.summary: Worried About Henry takes over DRUMSHEDS for a large-scale day party led by Wilkinson, Bou, Kanine, Luude and Flowdan, spanning drum & bass, jungle, garage and UK bass music.

events.title: Piano People at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: Piano People returns to DRUMSHEDS with an amapiano-rooted lineup including South Gidi with DJ Maphorisa and DJ Tunez, 2woBunnies B2B Thuto The Human, DJ LAG B2B General C’Mamane and more.

events.title: FUSE 18th Birthday w/ Enzo Siragusa b2b Rossi., Luciano, Marlie b2b Natalia Roth, Marsolo
events.summary: FUSE marks 18 years with its biggest London show to date: a three-room Drumsheds takeover featuring Enzo Siragusa b2b Rossi., Luciano, Apollonia, Dungeon Meat and more.

events.title: Goldie ‘Dare to Dream’ with Live Band, Orchestra and Special Guests
events.summary: Goldie presents two EFG London Jazz Festival performances of Dare to Dream with Elysian Collective, choir, his live band and guests including anaiis, Yussef Dayes, Natalie Williams and Cleveland Watkiss.

events.title: KOKO Electronic: Francis Mercier Weekender
events.summary: Francis Mercier takes over KOKO Electronic for a three-part weekender on 20, 21 and 22 November, bringing Afro-house and Caribbean/African-influenced house to Camden.

events.title: 4by4: DJ EZ, Todd Edwards, MJ Cole, Matt Jam Lamont
events.summary: DJ EZ’s 4by4 returns with Todd Edwards, MJ Cole and Matt Jam Lamont for an old-school/new-school UK garage night at Electric Brixton.

events.title: KI/KI at Magazine London
events.summary: Dutch DJ/producer KI/KI headlines Magazine London for Origins and Broadwick Live, with the event billed around trance and acid-techno influences.

events.title: fabric: Marcel Dettmann, Ellen Allien, Shonky, Marie Montexier, Josh Keit, Nate Oldfield + more
events.summary: fabric’s multi-room Saturday programme pairs Berlin techno institutions Marcel Dettmann and Ellen Allien with Shonky b2b Marie Montexier and local selectors across three rooms.

events.title: Calibre at The Roundhouse
events.summary: Calibre performs a three-hour set at The Roundhouse with Mark Ernestus, SP:MC and RAZE Sound on support, billed across drum & bass and dubstep.

events.title: Hamdi FC: Hamdi, Flava D, JAZ IMSKY, Sam Deeley
events.summary: Hamdi brings Hamdi FC to HERE at Outernet with Flava D, JAZ IMSKY and Sam Deeley, focusing on dubstep, UK garage and grime-edged club music.

events.title: Public Assembly '26
events.summary: The Cause, SC&P and Small Talk launch a multi-stage winter day-and-night inner-city festival with live acts and DJs spanning acid, post-punk and leftfield electronics.

events.title: fabric: Palms Trax, Ogazón, Mathew Jonson (Live), Antal, Joe Claussell, DJ Subaru + more
events.summary: fabric’s 28 November Saturday programme brings Palms Trax, Ogazón and Mathew Jonson live to Room 1, with Antal, Joe Claussell, DJ Subaru and floor length skirts across the other rooms.

events.title: KOKO Electronic: Kirollus (All Night Long)
events.summary: London digger Kirollus takes KOKO’s theatre open-to-close for a disco, boogie, funk, soul and house all-night session under the KOKO Electronic banner.

events.title: Noah Kahan
events.summary: Noah Kahan brings The Great Divide-era arena run to The O2 with special guest Bella Kay. The venue lists three London shows on 13, 14 and 17 November 2026.

events.title: Jungle
events.summary: Jungle return to The O2 for two nights with special guest Rio Kosta. The venue confirms shows on Tuesday 24 and Wednesday 25 November 2026.

events.title: Korn
events.summary: Korn bring their Euro Tour 2026 to The O2 with special guests Architects and Youth Code. The venue confirms the London headline show for Wednesday 4 November 2026.

events.title: Suede & Manic Street Preachers
events.summary: Suede and Manic Street Preachers are confirmed for a co-headline arena show at The O2. The event page lists Friday 6 November 2026 with doors at 6:30 PM.

events.title: HATSUNE MIKU EXPO 2026 EUROPE
events.summary: Crypton Future Media’s HATSUNE MIKU EXPO 2026 EUROPE opens its European run at London’s The O2. The confirmed London date is Thursday 12 November 2026.

events.title: The History of Jungle
events.summary: An all-day HERE at Outernet session dedicated to jungle and drum & bass sound-system history, with Roni Size, DJ Hype, Grooverider, Nicky Blackmarket, DJ Rap, Kenny Ken, Ragga Twins and major MCs.

events.title: Enter Shikari – LOSE YOUR SELF Tour
events.summary: Enter Shikari headline Alexandra Palace’s Great Hall on the LOSE YOUR SELF Tour with Holding Absence and The Callous Daoboys. Alexandra Palace confirms the run for 20–21 November 2026.

events.title: Squeeze with Billy Bragg
events.summary: Squeeze bring the Tried, Tested and Trixies Tour to The O2 with very special guest Billy Bragg. The venue confirms the London date for Thursday 26 November 2026.

events.title: Jessie Ware
events.summary: Jessie Ware is confirmed for The O2 with special guest Naomi Scott. The venue lists the show for Saturday 28 November 2026.

events.title: Myles Smith
events.summary: Myles Smith plays his debut show at The O2 on Friday 20 November 2026. The venue lists the arena date in support of his 2026 album campaign.

events.title: Dusky: Originals (2010 - 2025 Set)
events.summary: The sold-out main date of Dusky’s Phonox Originals concept, presenting an extended set made entirely from the London duo’s own catalogue.

events.title: Papa Roach
events.summary: Papa Roach are confirmed for The O2 on Sunday 8 November 2026. The O2 lists the show as on sale with doors at 5:30 PM.

events.title: IllumiNaughty: 20 Years Of Chaos
events.summary: The long-running psytrance brand celebrates 20 years with an indoor legacy edition at Studio 338 featuring Vini Vici, Electric Universe, Fabio Fusco, Hi Profile, Gaudi and more.

events.title: Cartulis 17th Year Anniversary
events.summary: Cartulis marks 17 years with an overnight anniversary session at FOLD, continuing one of London’s key underground minimal and techno party legacies.

events.title: Dusky: Originals (2010 - 2025 Set) - [2nd Date]
events.summary: A sold-out Phonox session from London duo Dusky built entirely around their own productions, added as a second date due to demand.

events.title: Soweto Kinch: Trilogy
events.summary: Saxophonist, rapper and composer Soweto Kinch revisits The Black Peril, White Juju and Soundtrack to the Apocalypse with the London Symphony Orchestra as part of EFG London Jazz Festival.

events.title: Fatoumata Diawara
events.summary: Fatoumata Diawara plays the Roundhouse Main Space as part of EFG London Jazz Festival 2026. The Roundhouse confirms the concert for Wednesday 18 November 2026.

events.title: I Love Acid
events.summary: I Love Acid opens a new London home at The Cause with Chicago acid house originator DJ Pierre, Lauren Flax, Posthuman, Jon Dasilva and a special guest TBA.

events.title: Supa Dupa Fly: R'n'B LDN Day Party
events.summary: A November edition of Supa Dupa Fly’s R'n'B LDN day party, from one of London’s long-running hip-hop and R&B party brands.
